description: Figure 3 is a bar chart that compares the performance of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev across various settings. The x-axis represents different settings, labeled as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The y-axis measures execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60. The chart includes bars for three different modules: DIN-SQL, TA-SQL, and TA-SQL (zero-shot). In the Simple setting, DIN-SQL has an execution accuracy of 60.21, TA-SQL has 63.14, and TA-SQL (zero-shot) has 56.19. In the Moderate setting, DIN-SQL has 39.64, TA-SQL has 48.60, and TA-SQL (zero-shot) has 51.35. In the Challenging setting, DIN-SQL has 32.32, TA-SQL has 36.11, and TA-SQL (zero-shot) has 56.19. The Total setting shows DIN-SQL with 75.34, TA-SQL with 81.08, and TA-SQL (zero-shot) with 81.08. The bars are color-coded, with DIN-SQL in light blue, TA-SQL in dark blue, and TA-SQL (zero-shot) in green. The chart is used to illustrate the performance differences between the modules in various settings.
